q: 各大区的已支付订单销售额（数量×单价）是多少？按销售额降序
sql: SELECT c."大区", sum(o."数量"*p."单价") AS v FROM orders o JOIN master_customers c USING(customer_id) JOIN master_products p USING(product_id) WHERE o."状态"='paid' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

q: 退款订单一共有多少笔？
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM orders WHERE "状态"='refund'

q: 哪个品类的已支付销售额最高？
sql: SELECT p."品类" FROM orders o JOIN master_products p USING(product_id) WHERE o."状态"='paid' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY sum(o."数量"*p."单价") DESC LIMIT 1

q: A 等级客户有多少个？
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM master_customers WHERE "等级"='A'

q: 2025 年每个月的订单数是多少？
sql: SELECT date_trunc('month', "下单日期") AS m, count(*) FROM orders WHERE year("下单日期")=2025 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

q: 华东区客户的平均订单数量（每单数量的平均值）
sql: SELECT avg(o."数量") FROM orders o JOIN master_customers c USING(customer_id) WHERE c."大区"='华东区'

q: 下单次数最多的前 5 个客户名称
sql: SELECT c."客户名称" FROM orders o JOIN master_customers c USING(customer_id) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY count(*) DESC, 1 LIMIT 5

q: 每个品类有多少个产品？
sql: SELECT "品类", count(*) FROM master_products GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

q: 各大区的退款率（退款订单数/总订单数）
sql: SELECT c."大区", avg(CASE WHEN o."状态"='refund' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) FROM orders o JOIN master_customers c USING(customer_id) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT product_id FROM master_products ORDER BY "单价" DESC LIMIT 1

q: 有多少客户从未下过单？
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM master_customers c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id=c.customer_id)

q: 2025 年与 2026 年已支付销售额分别是多少？
sql: SELECT year(o."下单日期") y, sum(o."数量"*p."单价") FROM orders o JOIN master_products p USING(product_id) WHERE o."状态"='paid' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
